title: LibreSwift
architecture: Decoupled iOS Swift compilation from macOS. Runs natively on Linux and WSL environments.
impact: Direct USB device provisioning, code signing, and interactive LLDB debugging within Linux editors.

title: potatoFace
architecture: Ultra-lightweight biometric facial authentication engine for Linux and Wayland desktop environments.
impact: Zero neural bloat operating at 14MB RAM overhead using Haar+LBPH integer mathematics and native layer-shell UI.

title: a-Ha
architecture: Dopamine-neutral Android launcher designed for high-focus workflows. Text-only interface with executive function scaffolding.
impact: Real-time binaural DSP synthesis (40Hz/14Hz), notification containment, and recursive task breakdown. Lightweight (4.3MB) and fully offline.
stack: Kotlin, Android NDK, DSP, Audio Synthesis

title: circles
architecture: DPI-camouflaged, end-to-end encrypted group video and messaging protocol engineered to defeat packet inspection.
impact: Zero-leak identity verification designed to maintain stability across hostile networks and aggressive packet drops.

title: aether
impact: Sub-millisecond execution overhead via OPcache preloading and strict POSIX request lifecycles.

title: Adaptive-Block-Sort
architecture: High-performance cache-conscious sorting algorithm combining block partitioning with adaptive in-place merging.
impact: Optimized memory locality outperforming conventional QuickSort and TimSort implementations on partially sorted arrays.

title: Imladris
impact: Local SQLite vector graph, neural knowledge indexing, and distraction-free spatial reading interface.

title: intraflow
architecture: Unified multi-tenant operations, automation, and security infrastructure platform for MSPs/MSSPs.
impact: Automated system orchestration, real-time audit controls, and granular role-based tenant isolation.
